name: M3_PPS330MI_ListPOTrans
description: List purchase order line history records for a specific purchase order and, optionally, a specific line, subline, and status. The operation returns one row per reported event on the line, including identification (purchase order, line, subline, status), organizational data (facility, warehouse, supplier), quantities and units, planning and transaction dates, cost and currency details, and transport and customs information. The **Number of filters** parameter controls whether the key inputs act as strict filters or only as starting positions in the result list, which is critical both for getting the expected records and for keeping response times acceptable in high‑volume scenarios.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number used to select line transactions to list.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number used to filter or position the listed transactions, depending on the number of filters (NFTR).

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Subline number of the purchase order line used to filter or position transactions in the list.

inputParameters.name: PUOS
inputParameters.description: Status of the purchase order transaction used as an optional filter or positioning key in the list.

inputParameters.name: NFTR
inputParameters.description: Number that controls how many of the key fields (PUNO, PNLI, PNLS, PUOS) are used as filters instead of only as positioning fields in the list. Higher values apply more key fields as filters, narrowing the returned transactions.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number for the listed transaction line.

outputParameters.name: PNLI
outputParameters.description: Line number on the purchase order for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: PNLS
outputParameters.description: Subline number on the purchase order line for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: PUOS
outputParameters.description: Current status code of the purchase order transaction.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the goods for this transaction are handled.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number automatically assigned to this goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: SUDO
outputParameters.description: Supplier's delivery note number associated with the transaction.

outputParameters.name: DNDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the delivery note was first printed.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Unique identity of the supplier for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: PRCS
outputParameters.description: Service process used for subcontract or repair purchase orders on this transaction.

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Date on which the purchase order transaction was recorded or planned.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this transaction affects material planning as a receipt or reservation.

outputParameters.name: RPQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated reported quantity for the line expressed in the product's engineering unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RPQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity reported for this transaction at its current status, such as goods received.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase order quantity is expressed.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: UGCD
outputParameters.description: Urgency code indicating the shortage situation and delivery priority for this item.

outputParameters.name: NEAC
outputParameters.description: Code indicating the next planned activity in the goods receiving process.

outputParameters.name: REOR
outputParameters.description: Sequence number showing the report order for call-off lines within a receiving number.

outputParameters.name: CHPO
outputParameters.description: Check points used for internal control or follow-up of this purchase order transaction.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person responsible for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: BOLN
outputParameters.description: Bill of lading number for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: CARN
outputParameters.description: Name of the carrier used for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: SMDT
outputParameters.description: Shipment date used as the planned pickup date for this delivery in material planning.

outputParameters.name: ARDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the shipment arrived at the receiving company.

outputParameters.name: NOPK
outputParameters.description: Number of packages included in the delivery for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: FWRF
outputParameters.description: Reference identifying the forwarding agent responsible for the shipment.

outputParameters.name: OEND
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether delivery of the order line is completed with no backorder.

outputParameters.name: SCOP
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the item's cost price is sent to the point-of-sale system.

outputParameters.name: SERA
outputParameters.description: Exchange rate used to convert the received cost to local currency.

outputParameters.name: DTID
outputParameters.description: Unique key that links this detailed transaction message to its original record.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when the transaction was made, in hours and minutes.

outputParameters.name: DLIX
outputParameters.description: Delivery number that uniquely identifies the shipment.

outputParameters.name: PACN
outputParameters.description: Package number identifying the package containing these goods.

outputParameters.name: PACC
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether this transaction line is included in a specific package number.

outputParameters.name: SDDT
outputParameters.description: Date the goods departed from the supplier, as reported at shipment advice.

outputParameters.name: NDDT
outputParameters.description: Date the goods depart from an intermediate carrier hub before final delivery.

outputParameters.name: ICDN
outputParameters.description: Customs import declaration number associated with the shipment.
